The [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] '''''Ruhger''''' and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Frigate [[Serpent (starship)|''Serpent'']] battled in the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]]. She was armed with a couple of Y-Wings and transports and they successfully destroyed the Imperial Frigate.
